entries.note: Run via npm run test:workspace so npm_execpath names the current npm CLI. This check starts npm start and observes Electron through explicitly enabled local CDP; it never substitutes a fixture for NOLF, Codex or the launcher. Temporary sidecar and Electron state isolate retained processes from the owner's workspace. The NOLF README is read/drafted/discarded only; real Save/conflict writes target a second temporary root added as test setup through the API. Reusing the launch command must preserve all session IDs and PIDs. Codex receives only its status command at human key pacing, not an inference task. Cleanup targets this test's sidecar, which owns its PTYs.
